description: By Lacey Christ, Fox News | Posted January 4, 2024 2:00 p.m. FIRST ON FOX – Republican Utah state Sen. title: Utah state senator opposed to COVID mandates, trans surgeries for kids announces bid for Congress - Mike Kennedy for Utah
